title: Establish public repository governance and project board
acceptance: Public repository contains the linked knowledge base and process documents.
GitHub Project is linked and seeded with scoped issues.
Repository checks pass remotely; main enforces PR and status checks.
G0 evidence links point to verified repository and board.

title: Decide multiplayer battle format
acceptance: Compare sequential turns, simultaneous planning and another reference-compatible option.
Describe two-player and eight-player participation, idle handling and exploration transition.
Record owner decision; do not assume the previous assistant proposal is approved.

title: Define customization scope and art pipeline
acceptance: List first customization dimensions and how outfit/body combinations stay compatible.
Define original FNF-inspired shapes, expressions, animation and readability targets.
Record camera and production-method options for decision, not silent adoption.

title: Define daytime behavior-to-power rules
acceptance: Specify predictability, duration, stacking and night/day reset options.
Provide three illustrative effects with tactical choices and comic consequences.
Keep the milk example and 30-second cooldown uncommitted.

title: Outline the first connected story episode
acceptance: Connect a daytime choice, sunset complication, battle and next-day consequence.
Include narrator placement, alternate outcomes and multiplayer choices.
Keep draft lore names provisional until approved.

title: Decide engine, camera and multiplayer architecture
acceptance: Evaluate candidates against selected battles, art pipeline and team constraints.
Define authoritative state, campaign ownership and disconnect strategy.
Record the selection and a two-client validation plan before implementation.

title: Define aging, memory loss and generation boundaries
acceptance: Describe aging triggers, mixed-age parties and what forgetting changes.
Separate narrative memory loss from account unlock deletion.
Identify first-game versus sequel boundary without locking assistant endings.

title: Set vertical-slice scope and playtest evidence targets
acceptance: Set a feasible slice scope after the battle, art and technology decisions.
Define a complete session and external playtest acceptance targets.
Specify actual build, save/load and reconnect evidence for G2.
